text:
There is starting to be some genuinely interesting AI-created film stuff (among a flood of slop), and I suspect this will only accelerate. The “is it art?” debate will grow

Benjamin’s 1935 essay “The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction” said its the wrong question.

Also it is funny/tragic/apt that the second sentence of an essay written in 1935 (“This does not diminish its importance, however; if anything, it underlines it”) reads to me as written by Claude.

The aura of the work (Benjamin’s use, not the Gen Alpha one) fades further.

最近很多人说 DeepSeek Flash 虽然便宜，但是 token 消耗量巨大，同样的钱，耐用性和性价比不如 GLM Flash
大家有同感吗？
